answer: Require each trading identity to post a refundable bond and earn non-transferable reputation from completed, independently attested jobs before handling large orders. A new identity starts capped at tiny trades; its cap rises only as verifiers confirm real deliveries over time, such as ridge surveying, glacier monitoring, or karst mapping, where results can be checked against public data. A Sybil attacker must fund a bond, wait out the slow ramp, and do genuine work for every fake identity, so cost grows linearly per identity, and cheating forfeits the bond.
